reviews.text:
Very nice mask for oily skin.
It is my second time to buy it. The essence feel like creamy milk. But it’s absorbed so fast and don’t make your face too sticky. Love you so much and I will purchase it again.
reviews.zh: 對油性肌嚟講係好好嘅面膜，已經係第二次回購。精華感覺好似 creamy milk，但吸收得好快，唔會令塊面太黏。真係超級鍾意，一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Serum Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text:
Very nice item for oily skin. You can feel your skin smoother. The essence be absorbed so nice.
I can’t wait to re-purchase it.
reviews.zh: 油性肌用好好。用完會感覺到皮膚滑咗。精華吸收得好正。等唔切想再回購。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Serum Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text: This mask is amazing for achieving a healthy glow! The combination of Galactomyces and Glutathione really helps brighten my complexion and smooth out skin texture. The sheet is thin, fits perfectly, and holds a lot of serum without being messy. It feels very nourishing and left my skin looking radiant and hydrated. I highly recommend this if you're looking for a quick brightness boost!
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜用完有健康光澤，勁正！Galactomyces 同 Glutathione 嘅組合真係幫到提亮膚色同撫平皮膚紋理。面膜紙薄，貼合度好，而且可以承載好多精華又唔會黐到手。感覺好有養膚效果，用完皮膚望落有光澤又保濕。如果想快速提亮，呢款極度推薦！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Serum Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text: Excellent sheet mask fit. It hydrates the skin beautifully and gives a great result. The ingredients work very well, especially if you use this type of mask every day or every other day. Provides excellent hydration — highly recommended.
reviews.zh: 面膜紙貼合度極好，保濕效果出色，效果好好。成分發揮好好，尤其每日或者隔日用呢類面膜嘅時候。保濕效果一流，極度推薦。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Serum Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text:
Review:

This sheet mask is amazing! It leaves my skin feeling very hydrated, soft, and refreshed. The mask fits well on the face and is soaked with plenty of serum. After using it, my skin looks brighter and smoother. I will definitely buy it again. ✨
reviews.zh: 評價：呢款面膜超正！用完皮膚感覺好保濕、柔軟又煥然一新。面膜貼面好啱，而且吸滿晒精華。用完之後皮膚望落更加亮澤幼滑，一定會再回購。✨

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Serum Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text: I tried the SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Serum Mask Sheet and it gave my skin an instant glow. The sheet mask fits well and feels comfortable on the skin without slipping. It’s soaked with essence so my skin felt deeply hydrated after use.I especially like using this mask before an event or when my skin looks dull and tired.
reviews.zh: 試咗 SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Serum Mask Sheet，用完皮膚即時有光澤。面膜紙貼合度好，貼住皮膚好舒服又唔會滑。精華好多，用完皮膚感覺深層保濕。特別鍾意出活動前或者皮膚暗沉疲倦嘅時候用。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Serum Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text: Just tried it and it made my skin glow and hydrated but I’m not sure if it brightened up my skin much
reviews.zh: 啱啱試咗，用完皮膚有光澤又保濕，但唔太確定有冇明顯提亮。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
